name: Git Atomic Commits
description: Inspects git status and diff on the host repository, groups changes into logical atomic units, and generates Conventional Commits with git add and git commit commands.
author: gidragir

examples.prompt: Create atomic commits for my changes in /data/projects/dotfiles
Inspect git status and generate commit commands

repo_path.description: Absolute path to the Git repository directory (defaults to /data/projects/dotfiles)
